edges.reason: mintGem reads gemPrice to compute the required ETH value.
mintGem checks totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens) <= MAX_SUPPLY, mixing supply math with the cap.
mintGem requires saleIsActive to be true before minting.
mintGem enforces numberOfTokens <= MAX_NFT_PURCHASE.
mintGem mints through _safeMint inside a loop, triggering receiver callbacks before the loop completes.
mintGem uses the caller msg.sender as the mint recipient.
Caller-controlled msg.sender is the recipient passed to _safeMint, which invokes onERC721Received on the caller.
_safeMint performs an external receiver callback through _checkOnERC721Received.
_safeMint calls _mint to create the token before the callback.
_checkOnERC721Received forwards _msgSender() into the external onERC721Received call.
withdrawAll distributes the balance through repeated _withdraw calls.
_withdraw performs a raw call{value} to an external address before verifying success.
withdrawAll reads the constant beneficiary addresses for distribution.
withdrawAll is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier checking _owner.
flipSaleState is restricted by onlyOwner against _owner.
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive flag.
reserveTokens is restricted by onlyOwner against _owner.
reserveGems is restricted by onlyOwner against _owner.
calcStartingIndex is restricted by onlyOwner against _owner.
setProvenanceHash is restricted by onlyOwner against _owner.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is restricted by onlyOwner against _owner.
setBaseURI is restricted by onlyOwner against _owner.
reserveTokens mints reserved tokens via _safeMint, invoking receiver callbacks.
reserveGems mints gems via _safeMint to an arbitrary address, invoking receiver callbacks.
reserveTokens mints to msg.sender.
reserveTokens writes block.number into startingIndexBlock.
reserveGems writes block.number into startingIndexBlock if unset.
reserveTokens bounds minting by MAX_SUPPLY.
reserveGems bounds minting by MAX_SUPPLY.
calcStartingIndex writes the computed startingIndex.
calcStartingIndex derives pseudo-randomness from blockhash(startingIndexBlock), a miner/validator influenceable block value.
calcStartingIndex requires startingIndex == 0, coupling randomness initialization to the block-derived index.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock overwrites startingIndexBlock with block.number.
setProvenanceHash writes the owner-supplied hash into VOG_PROVENANCE.
setBaseURI writes into _baseURIExtended.
_baseURI reads _baseURIExtended.
tokenURI reads the per-token URI from _tokenURIs.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to obtain the base metadata path.
Address.sendValue forwards ETH with a raw call{value} to a recipient.
Address.functionCallWithValue executes an arbitrary external call with value.
Address.functionDelegateCall executes an arbitrary delegatecall to a target address.

normalization_plan.reason: numberOfTokens is a parameter only used for validation and loop bounds inside mintGem.
_to is a parameter only consumed as the mint recipient inside reserveGems.
_reserveAmount is a parameter only used as loop bound inside reserveGems.
provenanceHash is a parameter assigned directly to VOG_PROVENANCE in setProvenanceHash.
baseURI_ is a parameter assigned directly to _baseURIExtended in setBaseURI.
tokenId is a parameter only used for lookups inside tokenURI.
_address is a parameter used as the call target inside _withdraw.
_amount is a parameter used as the transferred value inside _withdraw.
balance is a local variable holding address(this).balance inside withdrawAll.
supply is a local cache of totalSupply() used by reserveTokens (and its sibling reserveGems).
i is a loop counter local to the minting loops (mintGem/reserve functions).
_tokenURI is a local variable caching the per-token URI inside tokenURI.
base is a local variable caching the _baseURI() result inside tokenURI.
